deltas.reason: Raw Chromium skips malformed MIME. Frozen HTML type qualification only skips a parsed type known unrenderable; the target unknown-type profile attempts the valid URL.

deltas.reason: Raw Chromium prepending before exhausted gap restarts selection. Frozen gap keeps prepended nodes before the pointer; only later append resumes, without a new loadstart.
Frozen waiting continuation processes nodes inserted at the exhausted gap without repeating loadstart. Chromium remains pending after this append.
